note.summary:
3.1 Travel and tourism, including places of interest
Key focus
- journeys, holidays, transport, accommodation and attractions.

Core language
- Useful structures: मेरे विचार में; मुझे ... पसंद है क्योंकि; पिछले साल; अगली बार; आम तौर पर; मुझे ... चाहिए।
- Use appropriate prepositions, contrast completed events with future plans, and sequence a journey with time phrases.

Exam tips
- For comprehension, locate the exact word or phrase that proves each answer.
- In translation, preserve tense, negatives, quantities and relationships between people.
- In writing, add opinions and reasons, vary time frames, and check verb and adjective agreement.

questions.examTip: Use correct word order, postpositions (को, में, से, का/की/के) and verb agreement; place the main verb at the end.
questions.modelAnswer: मैं छुट्टियाँ पहाड़ों में बिताता हूँ क्योंकि वहाँ हवा साफ़ है।
questions.question:
Translate into Hindi:

I spend my holidays in the mountains because the air is clean there.

questions.examTip: Use correct word order, postpositions (को, में, से, का/की/के) and verb agreement; place the main verb at the end.
questions.modelAnswer: हम सुबह छह बजे निकले और दिल्ली जाने के लिए रेलगाड़ी ली।
questions.question:
Translate into Hindi:

We left at six in the morning and took the train to Delhi.

questions.examTip: Use correct word order, postpositions (को, में, से, का/की/के) and verb agreement; place the main verb at the end.

questions.modelAnswer: कल हमने एक पुराना किला देखा और स्मृति-चिह्न खरीदे।

Translate into Hindi:

Yesterday we saw an old fort and bought souvenirs.

questions.question:
Translate into Hindi:

I would like to stay in a campsite near the sea.

questions.examTip: Use correct word order, postpositions (को, में, से, का/की/के) and verb agreement; place the main verb at the end.
questions.modelAnswer: अगले साल यात्रा का खर्च बचाने के लिए हम बस से जाएँगे।
questions.question:
Translate into Hindi:

Next year we will travel by bus to save on the cost of the journey.

questions.examTip: Cover every bullet, use past and future forms where relevant, and justify opinions with क्योंकि.
questions.modelAnswer:
मैं छुट्टियाँ पहाड़ों में बिताता हूँ क्योंकि वहाँ हवा साफ़ है। हम सुबह छह बजे निकले और दिल्ली जाने के लिए रेलगाड़ी ली। होटल छोटा था, लेकिन कमरे से समुद्र दिखाई देता था। मेरे विचार में यह महत्वपूर्ण है और भविष्य में मैं एक नया अनुभव लेना चाहूँगा।

(English translation: I spend my holidays in the mountains because the air is clean there. We left at six in the morning and took the train to Delhi. The hotel was small, but the sea could be seen from the room. In my opinion it is important, and in the future I would like to have a new experience.)
